problem: Native XLSB text-import properties were skipped, and source-bound connection edits appended retained unknown records after the part end instead of preserving their owner/ordinal. Canonical serialization also changed an ignored password byte in an untouched Text connection. Native XLS external-cache semantics had no targeted regression.
changes: Add classic BrtBeginECTxtWiz text properties, encoding selectors, delimiters, qualifiers, first row, separators, source path, optional field-list presence and all ten field types. Read/write bounds and malformed count/collection checks are shared with authoring. Must-ignore flag bits and both None qualifier spellings remain representable.

Retain opaque records in their source owner and modeled-record ordinal. Known record kinds inside ignored collections remain opaque, so nested future content cannot create phantom connections or change scope. Unmatched positions are errors.

Preserve complete unchanged connection collections and an original common header when its typed header is unchanged. Update the existing connections part without deleting/recreating its OPC relationship or part identity.

Refuse modeled-layout changes in scopes constrained by opaque records and connection removal while query-table parts remain. Update the matrix to bounded support; these guards do not claim complete dependency teardown or Text15 support.

Add four native XLSB regressions and one native XLS cache regression, plus five synthetic tests. The previous malformed-classic-text skip test now uses the deliberately unmodeled Text15 collection; a separate negative test requires malformed classic text to fail.

verification_scope.text: Native connection1 carries classic text metadata: fallback WindowsAnsi selector1, overriding application selector45, delimited/comma/prompt true, tab/space/semicolon/consecutive/custom false, double-quote qualifier, first row1, decimal46, thousands44, delimiter0 and ignored bit20. The source path is exact and all three fields are General/start0. Application selector45 is not exposed as a numeric Windows code page. Outer data_file/connection_file are correctly absent because the path belongs to the inner text-import block.
verification_scope.database: Native connection2 preserves its Query - native-query-010 identity, Microsoft.Mashup.OleDb.1 provider string and SELECT command as inert data.
verification_scope.source: Six AC/UID wrapper records retain root ordinals1 and2. Changing connection2 description alters only its common header; all other record payloads/order and package members are exact. The untouched Text header retains its ignored pc=2 byte. Temporary save/reopen and inverse preserve original members and the source Package remains byte-identical.
verification_scope.text_edits: Comma-to-semicolon and Category-to-Text edits change exactly record positions5 and8 in the native 21-record part. Query tables, worksheet caches, tables and DataMashup remain byte-identical. Adding/removing a fourth Skip field is reversible after reopen. Reordering around opaque identities and removal of one/all query-dependent connections give precise UnsupportedFeature refusals.
verification_scope.xls: The native XLS has an external supporting book followed by a self reference, exact encoded virtual path, source sheets Sales chart/Sheet1/Sheet2, three sheet references and no external names. Source caches retain Sheet1 D6=49.75 and Sheet2 B4=14 with exact zero-based coordinates. Host Sheet1 is visible. This is a public read assertion; the internal external-link transaction module is not exposed as a Package editor.
verification_scope.guards: Synthetic cases cover all qualifier/encoding-category combinations, absent versus empty field lists, all field types, must-ignore flags, Unicode paths, row/path/count bounds, malformed/truncated classic text, duplicate collections, opaque root/local/trailing positions and known record kinds inside ignored collections.
verification_scope.limitations: No external file decoding, query/provider activation, refresh, credentials use, formula evaluation, macro execution or native Office reopen. Text15/model-data-source properties and query-table binary payloads remain opaque. Part/member identity is tested separately from whole-ZIP compression identity. The local specification references a separate ABNF file; these tests do not claim full External Data Connections grammar coverage.
